methodology: Fresh process and metadata cache each sample; OS page cache is not flushed. AB then BA in alternating rounds. Timings exclude fixture generation, bundling, GC and output hashing. RSS is end-of-operation; maxRSS is process-wide high water. p95 is nearest rank, not a latency guarantee. Local non-Git projects; no SSH or model invocation.
validationLimitations: Initial corpus placed 250 compressed rollouts outside the session adapter date tree. Project discovery covered 2000 files, but project history returned only 1750 conversations.
open.zstd50MiB returned zero messages and is not a valid compressed-read measurement. Preserve these samples as preliminary evidence only; use the validated results.
